messages:
lina: dropping a few screenshots and a short ask: can we sanity-check the density toggle, keyboard flow on expanded regression diffs, and copy on the bulk approval modal? figma: https://figma.redwood/app/eval-diffs

design-bot: uploaded 3 images (diff-list.png, density-toggle.png, bulk-confirm.png) :framed_picture:

devin: quick keyboard note: in dense mode the rows are 28px and hitting right-arrow to expand collides with our grid arrow navigation. on voiceover mac, expand is expected on enter/space. recommend mapping left/right to move between columns only and keep enter/space for expand.

maia: a11y voiceover nuance: when a diff expands we announce "Diff expanded" but don't move focus into the panel. screen reader users expect focus to shift to the panel header so they can find the new content. we should focus the panel container with tabindex=-1 and call .focus() after expand.

rachel: copy on bulk modal: header currently says "Approve items" which is vague. propose "Approve test results". body copy should call out that this will mark selected tests as passed for this prompt set and trigger downstream rollouts if configured.

asif: minor copy variant 3: "Mark selected tests as passed" — longer but explicit. also we should show the number of tests and a preview link "View selected" that opens the diff list filtered to the selection.

lina: good idea on the preview link. also we need to decide: require typing CONFIRM for bulk >50 tests? what's our threshold?

devin: safety threshold suggestion: >100 tests require typing, 20-100 show a mandatory checkbox + undo toast, <20 direct approve with undo. matches our current risk profile for customers with large suites.

maia: please ensure undo toast is keyboard focusable and readable by screen readers. aria-live polite works, but we also want the undo button to receive focus if the action is immediate (for accidental approves). maybe only auto-focus when selection size < 10 to avoid focus-jump for large ops.

rachel: analytics question: what's the event name for bulk approve? we should use consistent names for product telemetry: "eval.bulk_approve" with properties {count, from_view: "diff_list", method: "bulk_modal"}. pls confirm with infra.

asif: design nits: dense mode loses status color dot contrast for 2 of our colorblind simulations. can we add a patterned micro-icon fallback or stroke to the dot? also tooltips for status (Passed/Failed/Flaky) should be available on hover and focus.

devin: implementation note: patterned icon might be heavy; alternatively add label text visible at small size for dense mode: e.g., tiny "P"/"F" with aria-label still on the status element. that covers keyboard+screenreader+colorblind.

lina: consensus: show tiny label in dense mode + accessible tooltip on focus. for patterns we can track a follow-up if customer requests. i'll update mock: change modal header to "Approve test results", CTA to "Approve tests", add preview link, and density shows tiny labels.

asif: final CTA copy vote: "Approve tests" wins from content. i'll update style guide and push two microcopy variants in the PR for legal/regulatory review.

maia: i'll write the QA script: keyboard sweep, voiceover + NVDA checks, color contrast report, and test the undo focus behavior with selection sizes 1, 15, 60, 150.

devin: i'll scope shortcuts change: arrow keys only for navigation, enter/space to toggle. will add unit tests for focus movement and voiceover announcement timing.

lina: assigning: @devin (keyboard/focus fixes + PR), @asif (copy + style guide), @maia (QA checklist), @rachel (telemetry naming confirmation). thanks team :thumbsup:

rachel: ack, I'll confirm telemetry naming with infra and reply in thread.

lina: will share updated figma and new screenshots when ready later today. thanks all! :tada:
